sentences.text: Bashir Ahmed Mir ....Petitioner/Appellant(s)

Through :- Mr. O. P. Thakur, Sr. Advocate with
 Mr. R. K. S. Thakur, Advocate.
 V/s
Gh. Hassan Mir and others ....Respondent(s)
 Through :- Mrs. Monika Kohli, Sr. Aag for R-12 to 14.

Coram: Hon'Ble Mr. Justice Rahul Bharti, Judge
 Order
19.05.2023
1.
In a civil suit filed by the respondent nos. 1 to 4 on file no. 48/Civil before the court of learned Sub Judge, Ramban, the State of J&K and eight others were the defendants.
The defendant no. 3 in the civil suit was Gh. Mohi-ud-Din Mir who is father of the petitioner herein.

2. During the pendency of the civil suit, the petitioner's father Gh. Mohi-ud-Din Mir (defendant no.
3) came to expire on 03.03.2017.
The trial court of Sub Judge, Ramban in terms of an order dated 16.03.2017 came to direct the closure of evidence of the defendant nos. 3 to 9 which included the deceased-defendant no. 3.

This order was passed without legal representatives of the deceased-defendant no. 3 having been first brought on record by the respondent nos. 1 to 4 as plaintiffs and legal representatives first getting served and summoned in the case to appear.

Bashir Ahmed Mir vs Gh. Hassan Mir And Others on 19 May, 2023 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/127677335/
1 3.

entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text: It is only by virtue of an application filed on 27.05.2017 for seeking impleadment of three legal representatives of the deceased- defendant no. 3- Gh. Mohi-ud-Din Mir that the trial court of learned Sub Judge, Ramban came to order impleadment of legal representatives in terms of order dated 25.09.2017.

4. Without bothering to direct summoning of the legal representatives so impleaded in place of deceased-defendant no. 3, the court of learned Sub Judge, Ramban proceeded to decree the suit in terms of judgment and decree dated 30.11.2019.

5. The petitioner, herein as being legal representative of the deceased-defendant no. 3, upon knowing about the passing of decree adverse to his father came forward with an application before the learned Sub Judge, Ramban filed on 13.03.2023 in which the learned Sub Judge, Ramban came to put the respondent nos. 1 to 4 to notice along with other non-applicants.

6. In terms of said decree, besides granting declaration in favour of the plaintiffs, the defendant nos.
3 to 9 as being owners qua the suit land, the defendant nos. 1 & 2 in the suit i.e., State of Jammu &
Kashmir and Additional Deputy Commissioner, Ramban with Powers of Collector Land Acquisition for National Highway came to be restrained not to release the entire compensation in favour of the defendant nos. 3 to 9 by ignoring the rights of the plaintiffs.

7. The present petition has been filed by the petitioner under Article 227 of the Constitution of India with respect to the development having taken place in the form of filing of a contempt petition no.
31/Civil/Miscellaneous on 20.03.2023 by the respondent nos. 1 to 4 before the court of learned Sub Judge, Ramban.

8. Post filing of application on 13.03.2023 by the petitioner for setting aside the decree so passed against the dead person that too without first summoning the legal representatives of the deceased-defendant no. 3, with respect to the contempt petition so filed, the court of learned Sub Judge, Ramban, vide its order dated 20.03.2022 proceeded in issuing notice to the Collector Land Acquisition, Ramban.

9. It is with respect to this exercise of jurisdiction on the part of the learned Sub Judge, Ramban of entertaining the contempt petition of the respondent nos. 1 to 4 that the present petition has been filed to examine the legality and validity of the decision of the learned Sub Judge, Ramban to entertain the contempt petition.

10. Mr. O. P. Thakur, learned senior counsel assisted with Mr. R.K.S. Thakur, learned counsel appearing for the petitioner submits that the petitioner has come to know that the Collector Land Acquisition, Ramban acting on his own has come to release Rs. 1,90,27,257/- approximately as compensation in favour of the respondent nos. 1 to 4 by transferring of money into their respective banks which are Punjab National Bank Branch Chamalvas (Banihal) bearing account no.
1445002100000461 (IFSC Code:
Bashir Ahmed Mir vs Gh. Hassan Mir And Others on 19 May, 2023 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/127677335/
2 PUNB0144500), Jammu & Kashmir Bank Branch Banihal bearing account nos.
0080040100024340, 0080040100020181 & 0080040100008388 (IFSC Code:
JAKA0TUNNEL).

11. Mr. O. P. Thakur, learned Senior Advocate, submits that the release of the compensation by the Collector Land Acquisition in favour of the respondent nos. 1 to 4 is despite the fact that in the land acquisition award dated 15.10.2022 bearing no. CLA/NH-44/2022/1079-82, the respondent nos. 1 to 4 did not figure as entitled to such an amount of compensation by any stretch of claim and reference and, as such, it is only by reference to the contempt proceedings that the Collector Land Acquisition, Additional Deputy Commissioner, Ramban, had acted in panic mode to release the huge amount in favour of the respondent nos. 1 to 4.
12. Prima facie case is made out.

13. Issue notice to the respondents.
14.

Mr. Monika Kohli, learned Sr. AAG accepts notice on behalf of the respondent nos. 12 to 14 which includes the respondent no. 14 who is the Additional Deputy Commissioner, Ramban with Powers of Collector Land Acquisition.

15. Petitioner to furnish registered postal covers for the service of the respondent nos. 1 to 11 within seven days, whereupon the Registrar Judicial, Jammu to issue notices to the respondent nos. 1 to 11.
16.

In the meantime, the Branch Manager, Jammu & Kashmir Bank Branch Banihal and Punjab National Bank Branch Chamalvas (Banihal) are directed to freeze the operation of the account no.
1445002100000461 (IFSC Code: PUNB0144500), maintained with Punjab National Bank Branch Chamalvas (Banihal) and account nos. 0080040100024340, 0080040100020181 &
0080040100008388 (IFSC Code: JAKA0TUNNEL) which are maintained with the Jammu &
Kashmir Bank Branch Banihal to the extent of the amount so transferred by the Collector Land Acquisition, Ramban to the respective accounts.
17.

In addition, the Additional Deputy Commissioner, (Collector Land Acquisition), Ramban, is also directed to direct the concerned Branch Managers of the afore mentioned banks not to allow the operation of the above mentioned bank accounts of the respondents nos. 1 to 4 to the extent of the amount transferred and deposited by the Additional Deputy Commissioner, (Collector Land Acquisition), Ramban, without further orders from this Court.
A copy of this order be furnished to learned counsel for the parties under the seal and signatures of the Reader of this Court.
(RAHUL BHARTI) JUDGE JAMMU 19.05.2023 Shivalee Bashir Ahmed Mir vs Gh. Hassan Mir And Others on 19 May, 2023 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/127677335/
